hook.line: I got a free backlink from ChatGPT, and here's how you can do the same.
hook.visual: Man in a grey T-shirt talking to a selfie camera in a home office; white-box title 'I GOT A FREE BACKLINK FROM CHATGPT' sits mid-frame from frame one.

beats.what: Face to camera with the claim as a boxed title mid-frame
Cut to a closer take: asks viewers to favorite the video because it is huge for SEO
Cut to the laptop screen filmed with the phone: ChatGPT app sidebar, Sites menu
Cut to the ChatGPT chat confirming a chatgpt.site subdomain was created
Punch-in on the screen while he explains the domain-rating-72 backlink
Cut back to his face: you would pay a few hundred dollars for that link
Cut to the published page, 'The practical GEO readiness checklist', filmed on the laptop
Back to his face for the comment ask and follow ask

why_it_works: Result first: 'free backlink' plus a dollar value (a few hundred dollars) promises money saved before any steps
Phone pointed at the real laptop screen makes the proof feel unedited and repeatable
Asks for a favorite early (4 s), which turns the video into a saved how-to
Withholds the domain and asks viewers to comment for it, driving 295 comments
weaknesses: No captions after the opening title, so muted viewers lose the steps
Screen filmed at an angle with glare; UI text is hard to read on a phone
Two stacked CTAs (comment, then like and follow) dilute the ending
for_robert: Show the result as a boxed claim in frame one, then cut to the real screen as proof; Fred could react to the dollar figure instead of a plain face cut.
